model_card.description: A fine-tuned BERT model that classifies tweets related to disasters as either Urgent or Not Urgent. Useful for crisis response prioritization.
model_card.use_case: Disaster response teams can prioritize actions based on tweet urgency classification during crisis events.

intended_use.primary_use_case: Classify tweets into 'Urgent' or 'Not Urgent' categories for faster disaster response.

output_format.description: Returns a label: either 'Urgent' or 'Not Urgent'.

limitations: Model performance may degrade on crisis events significantly different from the training data.
May misclassify sarcastic or ambiguous tweets.

training_details.dataset: CrisisNLP HumAID Canada Wildfires 2016 Dataset (processed with urgency labels)
